title: Acqua di Parma: Colonia, Blu Mediterraneo and the 20ml eau de parfums compared
body:
Acqua di Parma is an Italian house known for its colognes: bright citrus, Italian bergamot and clean, sunny florals. Its range has grown to include warmer eau de parfums and the Mediterranean-inspired Blu Mediterraneo line. Most of what we stock comes in 20ml bottles and 12ml discovery sets, which makes the range easy to try. Here is every Acqua di Parma fragrance we stock, with its notes.

Colonia Pura

Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne (20ml) is the brand's classic cologne style: Italian bergamot, orange and petitgrain, then jasmine sambac, narcissus and coriander, over musk, cedarwood and patchouli. Fresh and clean, for warm days, the office and anyone who likes a light, citrus scent.

The 20ml eau de parfums

  • Zafferano Eau de Parfum (20ml, unisex): bergamot, bitter orange, coriander and mandarin, then geranium, jasmine sambac, orange blossom, rose and saffron, over tonka bean, vanilla and woods. Warm, spiced and floral.
  • Sandalo Eau de Parfum (20ml, unisex): Calabrian bergamot, lemon, orange and petitgrain, then cardamom and lavender, over sandalwood, amber and tonka bean. Citrus over a creamy, woody base.
  • Sakura Eau de Parfum (20ml, unisex): Calabrian bergamot, yellow mandarin and pink pepper, then cherry blossom and jasmine sambac, over musk. Light and floral.
  • Rosa Nobile Eau de Parfum (20ml, for women): bergamot, mandarin and pepper, then Italian rose, lily of the valley, peony and violet, over ambergris and Virginia cedarwood. A fresh, airy rose.

Oud Spice Eau de Parfum (bergamot, raspberry and rose; cinnamon, cloves and pink pepper; agarwood, labdanum and patchouli) is out of stock at present: use Notify me on the page. For more oud scents, see our oud perfume guide.

The discovery sets

  • Blu Mediterraneo Discovery Set (3 x 12ml): Mirto di Panarea (woody aromatic), Arancia di Capri (bright citrus aromatic) and Fico di Amalfi (fresh floral fruity), three takes on the Mediterranean.
  • Holiday Discovery Set (3 x 12ml eau de parfum): Osmanthus, Yuzu and Lily of the Valley, a warm floral, a tart citrus and a green floral.

Colonia Essenza deodorant stick

The Colonia Essenza Deodorant Stick (75ml) carries the Colonia Essenza scent: lemon, orange, bergamot, grapefruit, mandarin and petitgrain, then rosemary, rose, jasmine, lily of the valley and clove, over patchouli, white musk and amber. A good add-on for someone who already wears the cologne.

Which Acqua di Parma should you choose?

  • A classic fresh cologne: Colonia Pura.
  • Warm and spiced: Zafferano.
  • Citrus over creamy wood: Sandalo.
  • Light and floral: Sakura, or Rosa Nobile for a fresh rose.
  • Not sure yet: one of the 3 x 12ml discovery sets.

Good to know

  • Cologne, eau de toilette or eau de parfum? Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.
  • Buying a gift? See our mini perfume sets guide and perfume gift sets guide.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.
